findings.title: Current baseline misses YamlPanel buffer
findings.problem: handleShowVersionHistory captures formRef.getFormValues()?.yaml_config, but YamlPanel keeps unsaved edits in local state until panel Save/onUpdate. Opening Version History from the visual YAML tab therefore diffs against stale form YAML, not the YAML currently visible in the editor.
findings.impact: Violates the required Current-baseline behavior (unsaved editor YAML) and shows a misleading side-by-side diff for the primary visual-editor entry point.
findings.recommendation: Flush the active YamlPanel (saveCurrentTab / pass local value) before capturing currentEditorYaml, or change onShowVersionHistory to supply the visible YAML from YamlPanel.

findings.title: Previous-detail failure has no Retry
findings.problem: loadSelectedAndPrevious catches previous-detail errors, sets previousDetail=null, and does not surface error/Retry. The Previous Version tab becomes disabled as if no previous version exists.
findings.impact: Required edge-case behavior fails: Current remains usable but Previous has no Retry path; users cannot recover a failed previous baseline fetch.
findings.recommendation: Track previousDetailError separately, keep Previous enabled with a Retry control, and leave Current baseline working.

findings.title: 400 already-current skips summary refresh
findings.problem: handleRollbackConfirm catch only shows a toaster error. Spec/handoff require surfacing 400 already-current and refreshing version summaries so the target is no longer offered.
findings.impact: After a concurrent restore, users can keep retrying the same already-current version with a stale selector.
findings.recommendation: On rollback failure (especially 400), refetch versions (and refresh popup historical list) while keeping the history popup open.

findings.title: Restore confirm missing confirmDisabled
findings.problem: ConfirmationModal supports confirmDisabled, but Restore wiring only changes confirmText to Restoring… and relies on rollbackLoading inside the async handler. Rapid double-clicks can issue duplicate rollback POSTs before state commits.
findings.impact: Duplicate rollbacks create extra audit versions and race the refresh/reinit path.
findings.recommendation: Pass confirmDisabled={rollbackLoading} (and/or an inFlight ref) so the confirm control cannot re-fire while restoring.

findings.title: Partial rollback leaves editor stale
findings.problem: If rollbackVersion succeeds and fetchWorkflow fails, restoreTarget stays set, history/confirm remain available, and the editor is not reinitialized. Retry can POST rollback again against an already-changed server current.
findings.impact: Server YAML is restored while the UI keeps old/unsaved content; retry can create another version.
findings.recommendation: On rollback success, reinitialize from the rollback response yaml_config even if fetchWorkflow fails; clear restoreTarget / close confirm; surface refresh failure separately.

findings.title: Missing legacy editor entry-point tests
findings.problem: Spec requires entry-point coverage for both visual and legacy editors (VH beside Documentation, no legacy tab, docs-hidden still shows VH, create mode hides VH). Diff adds YamlPanel tests only; no WorkflowConfigField/legacy-path coverage.
findings.impact: Legacy path regressions (callback plumbing, docs-hidden VH, create-mode hide) can ship undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add WorkflowConfigField (or WorkflowFormFields legacy-mode) tests covering the shared header-actions entry-point cases.

findings.title: AI preRefinementYaml survives restore
findings.problem: Successful rollback does not clear preRefinementYaml. If Refine-with-AI was active, Revert to Previous remains and can overwrite the restored server baseline with stale pre-refine YAML.
findings.impact: Post-restore editor can be silently reverted to pre-AI content, undoing the rollback UX.
findings.recommendation: Clear setPreRefinementYaml(null) on successful rollback reinit.
